post.summary: Update the TraCSS Cat directly and submit change requests for satellites you own/operate via a csv.
post.description:
This endpoint allows a user to submit a CSV file to update the tracss catalog. The csv can be the same
format as the CSV submitted at the time of requesting an account (see documentation on tracss.gov).
or it may be any subset of fields from the signup csv. All valid fields are defined below.

The uploaded CSV needs to have headers, at a minimum, the noradId. Each row of the CSV must also have
exactly as many columns as described in the header.

**For example:**
noradId,alternateNames,constellation
12345,altName1;altName2,sat-constellation
12346,,sat-constellation
12347,altName3,

If a noradId provided in the CSV is not one your organization owns or has been granted access
to by a third party, a change request to claim that satellite will be made, along with a change request
to all the other fields provided for that satellite. Upon approval of the organization claim, if any
fields as part of that request are freely updatable, the update will apply as soon as the organization
assignment is applied.

**National Government accounts are restricted to only requesting changes on the following fields:**

- countryOfHeadquarters
- countryProvidingCommunicationLicense / countryProvidingCommunicationsLicense
- countryOfUNRegistry
- countryProvidingRemoteSensing / countryProvidingRemoteSensingOrNovelActivitiesLicense
- countryOfLaunchLicense

---

**All valid fields for a CSV (noradId is required):**

- satelliteName - Common name of the satellite
- alternateNames - Other names the satellite may be referred to as: ; separated list if multiple names
- internationalDesignator - Designator for the satellite indicating launch year, launch number and launch piece
- organization - Name of the organization in TraCSS the satellite is owned by
- countryOfLaunchLicense - 2 or 3 letter country code of the nation providing the launch license
- countryOfHeadquarters - 2 or 3 letter country code of the nation where satellite operations are headquartered
- countryProvidingCommunicationLicense - 2 or 3 letter country code of the nation providing the communications license
- countryProvidingCommunicationsLicense - Same as above, just an alternate naming scheme
- countryOfUNRegistry - 2 or 3 letter country code of the nation that registered the satellite in the UN registry
- countryProvidingRemoteSensing - 2 or 3 letter country code of the nation providing remote sensing or novel activities license
- countryProvidingRemoteSensingOrNovelActivitiesLicense - Same as above, just an alternate naming scheme
- constellation - Satellite constellation that the object is part of
- launchProvider - Name of the launch provider for the object
- launchVehicle - Name of the vehicle the object was launched on
- launchLocation - Name of the site the vehicle was launched at
- launchSite - Same as above, just an alternate naming scheme
- launchDate - Date the object was launched (see valid date formats below)
- deploymentDate - Date the payload was deployed (see valid date formats below)
- launchName - Name of the launch event
- generalFunction - The general function of the spacecraft. Choose from:
    - spacecraft engaged in investigation of spaceflight techniques and technology
    - spacecraft engaged in research and exploration of the upper atmosphere or outer space
    - spacecraft engaged in practical applications and uses of space technology such as weather or communications
    - spent boosters, spent maneuvering stage shrouds, and other non-functional objects
    - reusable space transportation systems
- objectType - The spacecraft type. Choose from:
    - Payload
    - Platform
    - Rocket Body
    - Debris
    - Unknown
- decayDate - Date the object decayed (see valid date formats below)
- estimatedTimeOnOrbit - A time estimate in years for how long the object has been on orbit (e.g., 2.5)
- estimatedTotalTimeOnOrbit - A time estimate in years for how long the object is expected to be on orbit (e.g., 15.2)
- expectedOperationalMissionLifetime - A time estimate in years for how long the object will be conducting its operational mission (e.g., 10)
- orbitPeriod - The actual time in minutes it takes the object to complete one orbit (e.g., 120)
- orbitInclination - The angle in degrees between the object's orbit and the Earth's equator (e.g., 25)
- orbitApogee - The highest altitude in kilometers the object reaches in its orbit (e.g., 5500)
- orbitPerigee - The lowest altitude in kilometers the object reaches in its orbit (e.g., 1200)
- plannedOrbitPeriod - Prior to launch, planned orbit period in minutes
- plannedOrbitInclination - Prior to launch, planned orbit inclination
- plannedOrbitApogee - Prior to launch, planned orbit apogee
- plannedOrbitPerigee - Prior to launch, planned orbit perigee
- plannedOrbit - Prior to launch, a combination of the 4 values above: a ; separated list in the order of period, inclination, apogee, perigee (e.g., 120;25;5500;1200)
- rcsSize - A qualitative classification of the object's radar cross section. Choose from:
    - Small
    - Medium
    - Large
- launchPiece - The piece designation from a launch to differentiate objects from the same launch
- orbitalRegime - The orbital regime of the object. Choose from:
    - Deep Space
    - LEO 4
    - LEO 3
    - LEO 2
    - LEO 1
- meanMotion - Number of orbits completed per day
- firstDerivativeOfMeanMotion - Indication of orbital decay in revs/day (±1e-8 to ±1e-3; TLE format: scaled by 2/3π)
- secondDerivativeOfMeanMotion - Indication of orbital decay in revs/day, often blank (±1e-16 to ±1e-11; TLE format: scaled by 6/π)
- bStarDragTerm - Drag term used for atmospheric drag modeling (0-1)
- raan - Right Ascension of Ascending Node in degrees
- eccentricity - A measure of how elliptical the orbit is (0-1)
- argumentOfPerigee - Indication of where perigee occurs in the orbit in degrees
- meanAnomaly - Position of the object in its orbit at the epoch in degrees
- revolutionNumberAtEpoch - Total number of revolutions completed at epoch
- additionalDeployments - Whether there will be additional deployments from the satellite (YES/NO). If YES, additional information can be provided.
- willAnythingBeDeployedFromIt - Same as above, just an alternate naming scheme
- operationalStatus - The object's current status. Choose from:
    - BACKUP_STORAGE_STANDBY
    - DECAYED
    - DEGRADED_OPERATIONS
    - EXTENDED_MISSION
    - NONOPERATIONAL
    - OPERATIONAL_MANEUVERABLE
    - OPERATIONAL_NONMANEUVERABLE
    - REENTRY_MODE
    - UNKNOWN
- orbitCategory - Category of the object's orbit. Choose from:
    - GEO
    - GSO
    - GTO
    - HELIOCENTRIC
    - HEO
    - INTERPLANETARY
    - LEO
    - LUNAR
    - MEO
    - PLANETARY
    - OTHER
- wetMass - Wet mass of the object in kilograms
- hardBodyRadius - The hard body radius calculated via a standard method in meters
- conjunctionMitigationCapabilities - Capabilities the object has to avoid conjunctions: ; separated list of:
    - chemical propulsion
    - electric propulsion
    - differential drag
    - object re-orientation
    - none
- contactInfo - First and last name of the prime point of contact for the object and any emails and phone numbers. Example:

    First;Last;satops@tracss.gov;satops2@tracss.gov;1234567890

    The first and last name must be the first two entries in the list, then add as many or as few emails and phone numbers as needed.

---

**The following fields do not require TraCSS Operations approval for updates and the expectation is
that owners and operators will keep these fields up to date:**

- alternateNames
- additionalDeployments / willAnythingBeDeployedFromIt
- operationalStatus
- orbitCategory
- wetMass
- hardBodyRadius
- conjunctionMitigationCapabilities
- contactInfo

Everything else is either provided from the DoD, is derived from DoD values, or from NASA. You may
submit change requests if the data is believed to be wrong or out of date. If this is the case, the
request will be sent to the TraCSS Operations team for approval. If approved, the submitted value will
overwrite the existing data and not be updated by the DoD/NASA ingests.

---

**Valid Date Patterns**

The following date/time formats are accepted for date fields. All times are assumed to be in UTC unless a timezone is specified.

| Pattern Example                       | Description                                               | Pattern String                               |
|---------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| `2023-123T14:30:00`                   | `Year + day-of-year + time (T separator)`                 | `yyyy-DDD'T'HH:mm:ss`                        |
| `2023-123 14:30:00`                   | `Year + day-of-year + time (space separator)`             | `yyyy-DDD HH:mm:ss`                          |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00.123Z`            | `ISO with milliseconds and Zulu`                          | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'`               |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00.12Z`             | `ISO with hundredths and Zulu`                            | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SS'Z'`                |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00.1Z`              | `ISO with tenths and Zulu`                                | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.S'Z'`                 |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00Z`                | `ISO with Zulu`                                           | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`                   |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00.123`             | `ISO with milliseconds, no timezone`                      | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS`                  |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00.123456789`       | `ISO with nanoseconds, no timezone`                       | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.n...]`               |
| `2023-05-01 14:30:00.123456789`       | `ISO with nanoseconds, space separator`                   | `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss[.n...]`                 |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00+00:00`           | `ISO with timezone offset`                                | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX`                   |
| `2023-123T14:30:00.123Z`              | `Year + day-of-year + time + milliseconds + Zulu`         | `yyyy-DDD'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'`                 |
| `2023-123T14:30:00.123`               | `Year + day-of-year + time + milliseconds`                | `yyyy-DDD'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS`                    |
| `2023-123 14:30:00.123`               | `Year + day-of-year + time + milliseconds (space)`        | `yyyy-DDD' 'HH:mm:ss.SSS`                    |
| `2023-123 14:30:00`                   | `Year + day-of-year + time (space)`                       | `yyyy-DDD' 'HH:mm:ss`                        |
| `2023-123T14:30:00`                   | `Year + day-of-year + time (T)`                           | `yyyy-DDD'T'HH:mm:ss`                        |
| `Mon May 01 14:30:00 UTC 2023`        | `Default date string`                                     | `EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss z yyyy`                 |
| `2023-05-01T14:30:00`                 | `ISO without milliseconds or timezone`                    | `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss`                      |
| `2023-05-01 14:30:00`                 | `ISO with space separator`                                | `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`                        |
| `2023-05-01`                          | `Date only, time defaults to 00:00:00`                    | `yyyy-MM-dd`                                 |

If set to 'most_recent', the most recent CA run's correlationId will be used, and will default to most_recent if not other params used.A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: CAStatus
parameters.description: Can be set to 'Complete' (case insensitive) in conjunction with correlationId to find the latest correlationId of a completed CA run.A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value)

parameters.name: ocmMessageId
parameters.description: OCM Message Id from an OCM that processed the CDM during super combo processing. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: object1Id
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: Please use object1ObjectDesignator param instead. Object1 Id (Primary Satellite Number). A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2) , Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: object2Id
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: Please use object2ObjectDesignator param instead. Object2 Id (Secondary Satellite Number of conjuncting satellite). A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: operatorOrganization
parameters.description: The name of the current operator's organization. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: tca
parameters.description: TCA (Time of Closest Approach). A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. get.description: Retrieve one or more OCMs from TRACSS. If no parameters are provided, the system will default to the header of all OCMs currently stored.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Authorization token to retrieve the Ocm(s).

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Owner of the satellite. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2) , Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Operator of the satellite. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2) , Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: objectDesignator
parameters.description: Object Designator (Satellite Number). A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: messageId

parameters.name: fileName

Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), Not Equal (<>Value), and Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first)

Retrieve one or more TraCSSCats based on query parameters. All fields may be pre-pended with the following optional operators:
Equal - (=Value) This is default and does not need to be included.
Not Equal (<>Value)
Greater Than (>Value)
Greater Than or Equal (>=Value)
Less Than (Less Than or Equal (<=Value)
Like (\*Value)
Not Like(~*Value)

Search parameters can also be a single value, or the following for searching a list or between values:
In (Value1,Value2) (list of comma separated values)
Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first)

Note that if the field value is a String, it will perform a lexicographical comparison so operators like Less Than on Strings may return undesired results.

get.summary: Retrieve On Demand Batch info. NOTE: it is encouraged to use the v2 endpoints for most up to date specs and functionality
get.description: Retrieve one or more On Demand Batches.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Authorization token to retrieve the TraCSS CDM.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Message Id (generated) from ASW that processed the CDM during super combo processing. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: batchId
parameters.description: Batch Id from the batch of OCMs that was uploaded. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: satNo
parameters.description: SatNo from the OCM that was uploaded as part of the batch. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2), Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: uploadDate
parameters.description: Upload Date from the OCM batch that was uploaded. Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), and Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first)

parameters.name: usableStartTime
parameters.description: usableStartTime from an OCM that was uploaded as part of the batch. Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), and Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first)

parameters.name: usableStopTime
parameters.description: usableStopTime from an OCM that was uploaded as part of the batch. Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), and Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first)

parameters.name: creationDate
parameters.description: creationDate from an OCM that was uploaded as part of the batch. Valid operators are: Greater Than (>Value), Less Than (<Value), Greater Than or Equal (>=Value), Less Than or Equal (<=Value), and Between (Value1...Value2) (smaller value first)

parameters.name: cdmFound
parameters.description: If a cdm is found as part of the batch on-demand run. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value)

parameters.name: createdBy
parameters.description: Username of batches to find. Can be a specific username or 'all' for all users. Defaults to requesting user's username

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Desired sort field and direction (Ascending = ASC, Descending = DESC), separated by a comma.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for the queried TraCSS CDM(s). Default is 0

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of TraCSS CDMs per page.  Max is 100000

get.description: Fetches announcement records from the database. Returns a JSON array of announcement objects. Supports optional filtering by ID, type, and pagination.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Authorization token to retrieve Organization records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the announcement. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2) , Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: announcementType
parameters.description: The type of announcement. A value with an optional operator that may be pre-pended to the value. Valid operators are: Not Equal (<>Value), In (Value1,Value2) , Like (\*Value), Not Like(~*Value)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. If no value is entered, the default value is 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: number of results returned. If no value is entered, the default value is 2147483647.
